name: 问小团
desc: 美团本地生活 AI 决策助手
desc_zh: 美团本地生活 AI 决策助手
solves: Asking about a restaurant or booking a service means scrolling lists, comparing them and jumping to another app. Wenxiaotuan answers inside Meituan and completes the order.
solves_zh: 问餐厅、订服务要自己翻列表、比对、再跳转。问小团在美团里直接给答案并完成下单。
best_for: When you want to decide where to eat or which service to book on Meituan and place the order on the spot.
best_for_zh: 你要在美团上决定今晚吃什么或办哪项服务，并当场下单。
notes: 唯一把本地生活实时商户数据接进对话决策并直连交易的助手，是「AI 参与交易」的代表样本 来源：https://m.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_32590949
